Jack Swigert replaced Ken Mattingly as command module pilot on Apollo 13, and the reason was rubella (German measles).

- [rubella-crew-swap] Blood tests from the 1970-04-06 physicals showed Ken Mattingly had no rubella immunity, and flight surgeon Charles Berry worried he could fall ill alone in the command module in lunar orbit.
- [ken-mattingly] Mattingly was the only one of the five prime and backup crew members tested without rubella antibodies, and he never contracted German measles. He was reassigned to Apollo 16 as command module pilot.
- [apollo-13] The change was made on 1970-04-10 at a KSC management meeting, making Jack Swigert the command module pilot.
